sentences.en: The administration cannot but look for alternative sources of revenue.
sentences.zh: 政府不得不寻找其他收入来源。

sentences.en: A budget deficit will occur because of a revenue shortfall.
sentences.zh: 由于收入不足，会出现预算赤字。

sentences.en: In our city, tourists are an important source of revenue.
sentences.zh: 在我们城市里，游客是重要的收入来源。

senses.zh: （国家的）岁入，税收，（土地，财产等的）收入，收益，所得，（个人的）固定收入,复数总收入,税务署，〈美俚〉税务官,税务局
